steps.message: Turn brightness to the max value.

Execute: adb shell "date; cmd -l; echo '---DISPLAY---'; cmd display help; echo '---POWER---'; cmd power help; echo '---SETTINGS---'; settings get system screen_brightness_mode; settings get system screen_brightness"
